documentedConstraintsReadBeforeDesign.windowsRow: Documented mechanism on supporting plans only; no concrete plan, adapter, or Windows configuration is approved or qualified.
documentedConstraintsReadBeforeDesign.sharedCompute: Slots share the App Service plan instances. Adding a slot does not add compute; reserve overlap headroom or consider separate plans.
documentedConstraintsReadBeforeDesign.strictWarmup: Swap warm-up accepts any HTTP response by default. Set WEBSITE_SWAP_WARMUP_PING_PATH and explicit WEBSITE_SWAP_WARMUP_PING_STATUSES; validate dependencies, configuration, authentication, state, and journey latency.
documentedConstraintsReadBeforeDesign.slotLifecycle: Native swaps can recycle former production workers and abandon long work. Routing cookies can pin clients; configured traffic weights are not proof that all users moved. A zero-percent staging allocation is not access control.
documentedConstraintsReadBeforeDesign.authority: Documented-supported is not authorization, target discovery, implementation, qualification, or native evidence. Native OS/SKU/subscription/resource group/region and separate execution approvals remain unresolved.
documentedConstraintsReadBeforeDesign.outcomes: Failed and unknown started journeys remain in the denominator; empty samples and users never moved give no migration proof. Verifier, user impact and cleanup remain separate.

scope: learning/S121 only; fixed fictional teaching data; no cloud or shared integration edits

browserHelper.qualification: Individual feature observations only; inactive lifecycle-recovery prototype is not qualified.

remainingWork.B-S121: Blocked until its native safety/data/Windows target/swap gates and separate approvals are met. Actual effective Windows code-slot configuration, strict readiness, routing, state, client and former-worker outcomes are still required.
remainingWork.D-S121: Incomplete; requires A and B children, original prerequisite parents and every source acceptance clause on the target configuration.
remainingWork.credits: At most one original S unit, accepted only once by the parent. Tests, proof, repair and refinements earn zero extra credits.
